headline: Bitcoin Tests Fibonacci Level Following Triangle Breakdown
summary: Cryptocurrency markets monitor live technical levels as Bitcoin tests its 38.2% Fibonacci retracement level after a triangle breakdown.
why: Technical analysis levels such as Fibonacci retracements are widely watched by cryptocurrency traders to gauge potential support and resistance zones.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Technical breakdown and Fibonacci test drive active trading strategies and short-term price volatility.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Technical breakdowns trigger automated trading rules and re-evaluations by market participants testing key Fibonacci support zones.
